rationale.conceptual: The method is established DFT with standard functionals and pseudopotentials. It requires careful implementation of spin-polarized calculations and appropriate convergence settings, but no new theory or custom algorithm.
rationale.execution: The pipeline consists of 4-5 stages: structure building, three separate DFT relaxation+DOS calculations, and energy extraction from DOS. It depends on proper DFT tool installation and pseudopotential downloads, but overall orchestration is moderate.

difficulty.reasoning: The paper uses standard DFT methods (GGA, ultrasoft pseudopotentials) to compute electronic structure. Conceptual difficulty is moderate because no novel algorithm is needed, but careful parameter selection is required. Execution involves a several-step pipeline (structure preparation, three DFT runs, DOS extraction), but no heavy data handling or complex orchestration. Resources are modest: small supercell, CPU-only, memory a few GB.
